01 / Campaign overview

TWO OCCASIONS.
ONE BRAND RELATIONSHIP.

Seasonal gifting initiatives developed to appreciate Vietnam-based KOLs and partners, strengthen relationships, and create opportunities for authentic brand mentions through unboxing, thank-you posts and social stories.

CAMPAIGN 01 / MID-AUTUMN

Mid-Autumn KOL Gifting

Culturally relevant gift packages distributed to finance, trading and investment voices, followed by KOL content monitoring and campaign reporting.

CAMPAIGN 02 / TẾT

Tết KOL Gifting

New Year appreciation gifts supported by recipient coordination, gifting logistics and monitoring of thank-you and unboxing content.

03 / My role & execution journey

FROM SOURCING
TO SOCIAL PROOF.

01

Planning

  • Supported vendor sourcing, quotation comparison and gift selection.
  • Coordinated packaging concepts, design details and production requirements.
  • Helped build and validate the KOL / partner recipient list.
  • Aligned scope, timelines and deliverables with stakeholders.
02

Setup & Delivery

  • Followed up on mass production, printing, packing and quality checks.
  • Coordinated recipient information and delivery tracking.
  • Monitored KOL posts, stories and unboxing content.
  • Tracked available links and supported brand repost / amplification follow-up.
03

Reporting

  • Consolidated gifting status and published KOL content.
  • Tracked posts, stories, likes, comments and available views.
  • Summarized participation, engagement and campaign efficiency.
  • Documented operational learnings for future seasonal gifting.

Responsibilities reflect the scope supplied for this portfolio case study; exact task ownership can be refined before publication.

05 / Key takeaways

RELATIONSHIPS
NEED OPERATIONS.

Build the list early

Recipient fit, relationship strength and posting likelihood matter more than gift quantity alone. Confirm the list and expectations before production.

Track beyond delivery

A strong gifting workflow includes recipient status, delivery confirmation, social links, content format and performance metrics—turning fulfillment into measurable advocacy.
